title: 二輪の荷運び台車
description: 袋や箱の運搬を表現する、湾曲した鋼管フレーム、奥行きのあるすくい板、荷支え、車軸、空気入りタイヤ風の二輪、グリップ、背面グライドを備えた縦型台車。パレットジャッキや買物カートとは異なる静止小道具。耐荷重・運搬作業・安全性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Upright two-wheel hand truck for depicting sack or box hauling, with curved tubular frame, deep toe plate, fixed vertical load-support strips, transverse axle, pneumatic-style tires, protected grips and rear glide rails. Distinct from a pallet jack or basket shopping trolley. Static unrigged prop; no load rating, hauling performance or safety validation. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
